events.verdict: Williams (CHA) and Stewart (DET) come together at the same spot on the floor and the contact is marginal.
Stewart (DET) firms up in Martin's (CHA) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Williams (CHA) brings his arm down towards the ball and incidental brush contact occurs with Cunningham's (DET) arm after the release of his driving shot attempt.
Bridges (CHA) and Ivey (DET) come together at the same spot on the floor and marginal contact occurs as Bridges attempts to slip away from the defender.
Stewart (DET) fails to the clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Hardaway Jr. (DET) legally contests Martin's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Ivey (DET) reaches in and makes contact with Ball's (CHA) wrist after his gather, which affects his driving shot attempt in the paint.
Bridges' (CHA) left arm comes down and makes contact with Ivey's (DET) head and shoulder, which affects his layup attempt at the basket.
Williams (CHA) establishes himself in Ivey's (DET) path and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick.
Ivey (DET) firms up in Martin's (CHA) path and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick.
Stewart (DET) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
Stewart (DET) legally contests Ball's (CHA) driving shot attempt in the paint.
Harris (DET) establishes himself in a screening position in Martin's (CHA) path and gives him the time and distance to avoid the contact.
Charlotte requests and is awarded a timeout as Ivey (DET) and Ball (CHA) engage during the throw-in. The timeout request precedes any possible illegal contact between the two players.
Ivey (DET) moves alongside Miller (CHA) and the contact prior to the release of the pass is marginal.
Harris (DET) commits a take foul on Mann (CHA).

Beasley (DET) brings his arm upwards into the ball, which causes it to begin to come loose and any ensuing contact with Miller's (CHA) arm is marginal. After Miller loses control of the ball, Harris (DET) reaches down and deflects the ball away and avoids making any illegal contact.
Beasley (DET) is already on the ground when Miller (CHA) reaches for the loose ball and any contact between the two players during the loose ball is incidental.
Holland II (DET) gathers the ball on his right foot and legally takes two steps to the basket.
Ball (CHA) brushes Holland II's (DET) arm when he reaches down towards the ball.
Bridges (CHA) remains in bounds before receiving the throw-in and he releases the pass before returning to the floor.

Ball (CHA) attempts to cut towards the basket as Holland II (DET) steps up to defend the drive and incidental lower body contact occurs that results in both players falling to the floor. This causes the ensuing incidental contact between Ball and Hardaway Jr. (DET).
Ivey (DET) legally contests Williams' (CHA) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Beasley (DET) brings his arm towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with the side of Miller's (CHA) head during his put-back attempt at the basket.
